description: Machine-checked ledger of every package that directly references the retained raw-Cypher compatibility surface (ports.RawCypherQueryStore / ExecuteReadCypher). scripts/rust_migration_ledger_check.py verifies this file against the code: 'compat' and 'permanent' entries must still reference the surface, 'migrated' entries must not, and packages that start referencing it without a ledger entry fail the check. See docs/engineering/rust-organizational-platform.md for the authority model and the per-caller capability gaps.

statuses.compat: still reads through the compatibility port; migration work remains
statuses.permanent: retained by design (runtime-authored query text); not migration work
statuses.migrated: no longer references the compatibility surface

aggregations, optional match, variable-length traversal (per graph rule)

callers.note: ask flow is a permanent resident (LLM-drafted Cypher); probe counts still migrate, then flip this entry to permanent

callers.blocked_on: variable-length traversal with relation whitelist, union variants, substring predicates, batched traversal

callers.note: shadow/experiment evaluation is a permanent resident (rule.Spec.Graph.Query); grounding still migrates, then flip this entry to permanent
